author_role: none; no production or formal test edits
checks: All original URI document/snapshot and permanent idempotency identities are retained.
The helper performs ASCII and percent transformations without locale, network, DNS or process-global state.
Only one production documents INSERT exists and writes deletion_key; URLs are not updated by production paths.
Existing version<14 migration adds/repopulates all documents including tombstones in its established transaction.
Alias lookup is owner-scoped, key-deduplicated, bounded to 1001 rows per ordered range and a total 1000 accepted fences.
Direct old metadata missing a fence gets only sequence0; malformed existing proof is not treated as absent.
Redirect caches retain their required chain proof; metadata CAS, request profile, freshness and owner checks stay in place.
Revalidation checks and final cached body projection reuse the same deletion comparison key.
Historical by-ID snapshot/evidence reads are intentionally not expanded to alias-group erasure.
Site map_url, publication identities, source selection and backing adapters are not modified.
limitations: Old processes already holding schema13 connections must be stopped before migration; schema14 startup rejection is not an in-process watcher.
Existing map/crawl projection APIs and ordinary local search are not comprehensively rekeyed; this is the explicit deletion/cache/commit boundary.
Independent synthetic probes do not establish production source availability, relevance or a full blueprint acceptance.
